name: Mystic Code
source: One day, a 'police murder' was commited. The dead police was a 'Frog Mystic'. Mystics are mysterious creatures, with the features of unique plants or animals. In the eyes of non-Mystics, they look like normal people, but Mystics are able to recognize each other. A team of Mystic investigators must, against all odds, discover the truth behind the mystery and confront the murderer!
translation: 有一天，发生了一起“警察谋杀案”。死去的警察是一名“青蛙神秘主义者”。神秘主义者是神秘的生物，具有独特的植物或动物的特征。在非神秘主义者眼中，他们看起来和普通人没什么两样，但神秘主义者却能够认出对方。一队神秘调查员必须排除万难，找出谜团背后的真相，并对抗凶手！
